THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5
I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and
Lands, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of
that the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below
are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the
provisions of that Act.

extent 13.1997 hec, depicted in Surveyor General’s Advance
